mc-1Jgd.title: Landscape: tiny city-state on a coast
mc-1Jgd.summary: A tiny coastal city-state a few kilometres from the Italian border. If you see a dense, glitzy city squeezed onto a Mediterranean hillside, think Monaco.

differs.how: Italy is far larger with plenty of rural areas

mc-3BaL.title: Plants: planted palm trees
mc-3BaL.summary: Palm trees planted along streets and in gardens are common.

mc-6LyB.title: Coverage: lots of tunnels
mc-6LyB.summary: A lot of the coverage is inside road tunnels.

mc-Dzdt.title: Google car: trekker on a boat in the harbour
mc-Dzdt.summary: In the harbour the camera is carried on a boat by a person with brown hair and sunglasses, with the skyline, hills and expensive yachts behind. Shows up a lot in competitive modes.

mc-W7d3.title: Landscape: steep hills, little greenery
mc-W7d3.summary: Very hilly ground. The few spots that are not built up show Mediterranean plants.

mc-c3Rx.title: Plate: short, no blue strip
mc-c3Rx.summary: Monaco plates are short and have no blue strip. Most cars you see are still ordinary French plates, often with old yellow rear plates because of the old Gen 2 coverage.

mc-dU2m.title: Houses: dense luxury apartment blocks
mc-dU2m.summary: Packed apartment buildings with neoclassical details and pastel colours, like southern France or northern Italy but richer. There are essentially no rural areas.

differs.how: French towns look less luxurious and have countryside nearby

mc-gJQj.title: Vehicles: rows of parked mopeds
mc-gJQj.summary: Rows of parked mopeds line the streets, a common sight.
